# Plugin development

The plugin guide, a gallery of the shared components, and hot reload that waits for idle.

Pack id `develop`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/plugin-guide`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/plugin-guide/README.md) — A developer Plugin Guide page: a static, build-time catalog of DSH public extension surfaces (dshx SDK entry points, native slots, owned registries, contracts, Host APIs, shared modules, catalog surfaces) with scope, mode, replacement risk and source links, plus a read-only agen…
2. [`@dshfiles/component-gallery`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/component-gallery/README.md) — One page that shows every shared plugin-ui component, animated ones included, grouped in tabs
3. [`@dshfiles/hmr-gate`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/hmr-gate/README.md) — Web client HMR transport that only announces a rebuilt plugin while its Host half is the code the running Host loaded.

None.

## Features

From the onboarding feature catalog: 7 features, the 1 curated ones first.

### Curated

1. **Browse where a plugin can extend DSH** (`plugin-guide`, settings) — Settings › Plugin guide is a developer page over a static catalog generated at build time from public declarations: dshx SDK entry points (each checked against the dshx index it is imported from), the native Client slots of create-dshx's offline slot reference, every owned plugi…

### More

1. **Browse every shared component on one page** (`component-gallery`, settings) — Browse every shared UI component live on one page, filtered by name.
2. **Plugin updates waiting for a restart** (`hmr-gate`) — The Plugins page lists plugin updates that wait for a DSH restart, and the page keeps working meanwhile.
3. **Plugin updates waiting for a restart in the Inbox** (`hmr-gate`, inbox) — The Inbox shows one item naming plugin updates that wait for a restart, and when to restart.
4. **Waiting updates join the restart notice** (`hmr-gate`) — Plugin updates that need a restart are named in the one Restart pending item in the status bar.
5. **Reload a plugin without restarting DSH** (`hmr-gate`) — Off by default: a plugin marked safe can reload inside the running DSH without a restart.
6. **Plugin updates wait for a hidden or idle moment** (`hmr-gate`) — Plugin updates apply only when the page is hidden or you have been idle for a while.

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on Plugin development under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `develop`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs develop` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
